name: What is a handyman service?
description: A handyman service offers a range of home repair, maintenance, and improvement tasks, ideal for jobs not requiring a specialized contractor.

acceptedAnswer.text: A handyman service provides skilled professionals to perform a variety of home repair, maintenance, and improvement tasks. This can include minor plumbing, electrical work, carpentry, painting, drywall repair, and general upkeep that doesn't require a specialized contractor. It's ideal for tasks that are too small for a general contractor but too complex or time-consuming for a homeowner to do themselves. HH Remodeling LLC offers comprehensive handyman services for residents in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker.
